All comparisons included within this Part II, Item 7, Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations , refer to results for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to the year ended December 31, 2024, unless stated otherwise. Additionally, all financial results and share repurchases other than per share amounts are reported in millions, unless stated otherwise. Per share amounts are reported in ones. Please refer to our Annual Report on Form 10-K ( 2024 Annual Report ) for a discussion of the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023. OVERVIEW ITT Inc., through its worldwide subsidiaries, is a diversified manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions for the transportation, industrial and energy markets. Our product and service offerings are organized into three segments: Motion Technologies (MT), Industrial Process (IP), and Connect & Control Technologies (CCT). Refer to Part I, Item 1, Description of Business , for a further overview of our company, segments, products and service offerings, and other information about the business. Effective January 1, 2025, the Company changed its method of determining the cost for certain inventories from a last-in, first-out (LIFO) to first-in, first out (FIFO) for all inventories previously accounted for under LIFO. For additional information on the change in accounting principle, refer to Note 1, Description of Business and Basis of Presentation . Management’s discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations have been adjusted to reflect the change in accounting principle. credit_strengths.text: Gross leverage sits well below the sector median and the balance sheet is in a net cash position, with cash and short-term investments exceeding interest-bearing debt; the indicative financial risk profile is Minimal on a leverage basis. This provides substantial cushion against cyclical swings in the transportation, industrial and energy end markets served.

Interest coverage is strong and comfortably above the sector median, reflecting modest absolute interest expense against operating income. Coverage did ease year over year as debt rose, so the trend direction is mildly negative even though the absolute level remains robust for an investment-grade-style industrial issuer.

key_risks.text: The debt note shows a shift toward short-dated funding: commercial paper outstanding is concentrated in the Euro program with maturities under three months, and the term loan carries a two-year maturity. This creates refinancing concentration and exposes the issuer to rollover and rate-reset risk if credit markets tighten.

Disclosed covenants under the term loan restrict additional debt, liens, mergers, asset disposals and liquidation, and require a consolidated indebtedness to earnings ratio to be maintained. A covenant breach would constrain capital deployment; the leverage definition was amended, which warrants monitoring of headroom against the disclosed threshold.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating income covers interest expense many times over and EBITDA coverage is roughly double the sector median, so scheduled debt service appears comfortably met from earnings. Coverage nonetheless declined year over year as borrowings grew, and the absence of a reported operating cash flow figure prevents confirmation of cash-based debt service capacity.

Liquidity is a clear strength: the current ratio is far above the sector median and above one, with current assets covering current liabilities comfortably. Cash on hand exceeds total debt, so near-term maturities including commercial paper and the term loan appear fundable from the existing liquidity pool rather than reliant on external refinancing.

overall_credit_view.text: The credit profile is strong: net cash, leverage below the sector median, superior interest and EBITDA coverage, and a Safe Altman zone. Operating margin exceeds the sector median though it narrowed year over year, and revenue grew across all three segments, supporting the view that earnings durability underpins debt capacity.

Capital deployment is the main judgement point: buybacks and dividends together are sizeable relative to capital expenditure, and without a reported operating cash flow figure we cannot confirm that internal cash generation covers distributions. Our forward view is that distributions absorb a meaningful share of cash flow, leaving less deleveraging buffer.

credit_strengths.text: 總槓桿率遠低於行業中位數，資產負債表處於淨現金狀況，現金及短期投資超過計息債務；按槓桿基礎計算，指示性財務風險狀況為極低。這為其所服務的運輸、工業及能源終端市場的週期性波動提供了相當大的緩衝。
利息覆蓋率強勁，且穩妥地高於行業中位數，反映絕對利息支出相對於營業收入而言較為溫和。隨著債務上升，覆蓋率按年有所緩和，因此趨勢方向略為負面，儘管絕對水平對一家投資級別的工業發行人而言仍然穩健。

key_risks.text: 債務附註顯示融資轉向短期：未償還商業票據集中於歐元計劃，到期期限少於三個月，而定期貸款期限為兩年。這造成再融資集中，並使發行人面臨信貸市場收緊時的展期及利率重設風險。
定期貸款項下披露的契約限制額外債務、留置權、合併、資產處置及清盤，並要求維持綜合債務對盈利比率。違反契約將限制資本部署；槓桿定義已被修訂，值得監察相對於披露門檻的餘裕。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 營業收入覆蓋利息支出多倍，EBITDA覆蓋率約為行業中位數的兩倍，因此預定債務償付似乎可從盈利中從容滿足。然而，隨著借款增加，覆蓋率按年下降，且缺乏呈報的經營現金流數字，無法確認以現金為基礎的債務償付能力。
流動性明顯是優勢：流動比率遠高於行業中位數且高於一，流動資產從容覆蓋流動負債。手頭現金超過債務總額，因此短期到期債務（包括商業票據及定期貸款）似乎可從現有流動性池中撥付，而非依賴外部再融資。

overall_credit_view.text: 信貸狀況強勁：淨現金、槓桿低於行業中位數、利息及EBITDA覆蓋率優越，且處於Altman安全區。營業利潤率超過行業中位數，儘管按年收窄，而收入於全部三個分部均有所增長，支持盈利持久性支撐債務能力的觀點。
資本部署是主要判斷點：回購及股息合計相對於資本開支而言規模可觀，且缺乏呈報的經營現金流數字，我們無法確認內部現金產生足以覆蓋分派。我們的前瞻觀點是，分派佔用現金流的相當份額，留下較少的去槓桿緩衝。
